legalAndScenarios.title: Legal & Scenarios Module (The Verdict & Library)
actions: Legal References: Replace Zimbabwean Acts (e.g., Dangerous Drugs Act [Cap 15:02]) with Botswana's Drugs and Related Substances Act, Penal Code (Cap 08:01), and Liquor Act.
Quiz Content: Refactor scenarios in The Verdict game to reflect Botswana Police Service (BPS) procedures, magistrate court structures, and local sentencing frameworks.

vernacularGames.title: Vernacular, Language & Games
actions: Title Adjustments: Replace Shona titles with Setswana equivalents (e.g., replace Chokwadi Kana Nhema with Nnete kapa Maaka for Truth or Lie).
Slang Encyclopedia: Update the Street Name Quiz and dictionary datasets with Botswana youth slang terms (e.g., nyaope/unyaope, mooko, dijo, maratagole, chibuku).

educationalDatabases.title: Educational & Administrative Databases
actions: School Directory: Replace the Zimbabwean database with Botswana's Ministry of Basic Education school registry categorized across Botswana's 10 administrative districts (e.g., South-East, Kweneng, Central, North-East).
Regional Mapping: Update GPS facility matching to default to Botswana regional centroids (Gaborone, Francistown, Lobatse, Maun, Kasane).
